violations.RP-WIDTH-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 3 public source(s), verdict confirmed; no official text was opened. violations.RP-HEADROOM-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 3 public source(s), verdict corrected; no official text was opened. violations.RP-DOOR-SWING-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 3 public source(s), verdict confirmed; no official text was opened. Reference is right for 2023. This concerns the egress rule, not renumbering of the 90 degree rule. Source: MN DLI minutes.

violations.RP-IDMARK-EGC-GREEN-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 2 public source(s), verdict corrected; no official text was opened. Use 250.119(A) as the reference. violations.RP-IDMARK-WHITE-HOT-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 2 public source(s), verdict corrected; no official text was opened. violations.RP-IDMARK-SVCDISC-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 2 public source(s), verdict confirmed; no official text was opened. Fine for 2023. If the app moves to 2026, the dwelling wording and compliantFact need updating. Check whether the app also has an exterior emergency-disconnect violation to avoid overlap. 2026: Changed. 230.70(B) now requires 'SERVICE DISCONNECT' marking on or beside each service disconnect, and one- and two-family dwellings also need 'EMERGENCY DISCONNECT' (red background, white text, at least 1/2 in.). 230.85 was deleted and moved into 230.70; new 230.70(D) requires a plaque for other sources. Sources: electricallicenserenewal 1873 and 1878, ECM top-25 article, Minnesota DLI summary. ECM and the CE site differ slightly on which wording applies to which building type.
violations.RP-IDMARK-NEUTRAL-FEEDER-001|nec: Doubt (medium): Checked against 2 public source(s), verdict confirmed; no official text was opened.
